modules.title: 一项“导出会议纪要”需求怎样写成可协作的 PRD
PRD 怎样让团队对同一件事达成共识

items.title: 先写用户问题和目标
items.text: 说明哪类用户在什么场景遇到什么阻碍，以及这次希望改变什么结果；功能名称本身不能代替问题。

items.title: 明确范围与非目标
items.text: 写清本次必须覆盖的用例、约束和暂不处理的内容，让设计与开发知道哪些选择仍可讨论。

items.title: 确立衡量成效的验收标准
items.text: 用可观察的验收条件或成功信号检查结果，并把假设、待确认问题和后续更新留在同一份协作文档中。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: PRD 不是路线图、技术设计或线框图：路线图安排一段时间内的方向与优先级，技术设计说明系统怎样实现，线框图呈现界面结构；PRD 聚焦当前需求的用户问题、目标、范围和成功标准，可以链接这些材料，但不能由它们互相替代。

lessonPractice.title: 团队准备做“会议纪要一键导出”。下面哪组内容最适合作为这项需求的 PRD 主体？

options.label: 目标用户与导出障碍、要支持和暂不支持的场景、成功标准、假设与待确认问题
options.feedback: 对。这组内容说明了为什么做、为谁做、做到哪里以及怎样判断有效，团队仍可在边界内讨论具体实现。

options.label: 第三季度所有项目的先后顺序、负责人和预计发布日期
options.feedback: 这些内容主要属于路线图或项目计划，不能替代当前导出需求的用户问题、范围和成功标准。

options.label: 数据库表、接口字段和每个页面像素都预先写死，不说明用户问题或验证标准
options.feedback: 这把技术设计和线框细节当成了需求本身。团队仍不知道为什么这样做，也无法判断交付后是否解决了用户问题。

en.title: A team is preparing a one-click meeting-notes export. Which set of content best forms the core of its PRD?

options.label: Target users and export pain points, in-scope and out-of-scope cases, success criteria, assumptions, and open questions
options.feedback: Correct. This explains why the work matters, who it serves, its boundaries, and how to judge the result while leaving implementation choices open.

options.label: The sequence, owners, and projected dates for every third-quarter initiative
options.feedback: That is primarily roadmap or project-planning information. It does not replace the user problem, scope, and success criteria for this export requirement.

options.label: Predefine every database table, API field, and screen pixel without stating the user problem or validation criteria
options.feedback: This mistakes technical design and wireframe detail for the requirement itself. The team still cannot tell why it is building this or whether it solved the problem.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请把“会议纪要一键导出”整理成一页 PRD，写清目标用户、当前问题、目标、范围、非目标和成功标准。把没有依据的内容标成待确认，先不要替团队决定技术方案或画线框图；整理后再检查每条需求能不能被验收。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Turn “one-click meeting-notes export” into a one-page PRD covering the target users, current problem, goal, scope, non-goals, and success criteria. Mark unsupported details as open questions instead of deciding the technical solution or drawing wireframes for the team; then check that every requirement can be verified.

references.title: 如何创建产品需求文档（PRD）
references.title_en: How to create a product requirements document (PRD)

learning.assumes: You have seen a feature change as people pass it along in conversation.
learning.outcome: You can tell whether a PRD defines the user problem, scope, and success criteria, and what belongs in a roadmap, technical design, or wireframe instead.

modules.title: Turn one export request into a PRD the team can use
How a PRD aligns a team on one request

items.title: Start with the user problem and goal
items.text: Name the user, situation, and obstacle, then state the result the work should change.

items.title: Set the scope and non-goals
items.text: State required cases, constraints, and what this release will not address.

items.title: Agree on evidence
items.text: Use observable acceptance criteria or success signals, and keep assumptions and open questions with the request.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: A PRD is not a roadmap, technical design, or wireframe. It defines the current problem, goal, scope, and success criteria, while those materials cover timing, implementation, or screen structure.
